title: ULPF normalized event (OCSF JSON + _lineage envelope)
description: The runtime's output record for one event: an OCSF event object (class_uid and the attributes the pack maps, nested as OCSF objects) plus the mandatory _lineage block (architecture §4.1) and the unmapped vendor extensions. OCSF attributes themselves are validated against the pinned class table by the pack, not enumerated here; this contract fixes the envelope so the learning plane's differential test (P3) can compare outputs field for field. Frozen at P2 exit.

category_uid.description: 1.1.0. Derived from the class via the pinned table.

type_uid.description: 1.1.0. class_uid * 100 + activity_id (0 when activity_id is absent).

severity_id.description: 1.1.0. Pack-declared (constant or mapped) with provenance — a judgement, never derived.

metadata.description: 1.1.0. OCSF metadata: version and product from the pack.

unmapped.description: Vendor extensions carried under their pack-declared names; values are the decoded span values.

schema_version.description: 1.1.0 (P3 boundary) is additive over 1.0.0; 1.0.0 documents remain valid.

framing.description: Structured framing record: reconstruction is raw_prefix + raw + raw_suffix (base64).

routing_signature.description: The L1–L4 signature key the event matched, as computed by the router.

normalization_version.description: Corrections emit a new version with derived_from (invariant 8, P8); v1 is never rewritten.

absent.description: Mapped mandatory attributes that have no value in this event, with the cause. Mandatory is a mapping obligation, not a per-event presence requirement: the event is usable; the absence is a recorded fact. 'structural' = the source carried no span for the field; 'uncoercible' = a span exists but its value failed coercion (e.g. a vendor null marker such as Squid's '-'). Omitted when empty.

cause.description: declared_null (1.1.0): the source carried a pack-declared null marker for the field.
